verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is an AI video-generation tool, so output provenance is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions C2PA metadata, content credentials, or a disclosed watermark on generated videos. The only related item is a log recording the source, author and license of assets it finds online. That covers input licensing, not provenance signals embedded in the output, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a marketer, generated output carries documented provenance signals (C2PA metadata or a disclosed watermark) I can point to
